run_sft_training: run supervised fine-tuning on a causal language model with a HuggingFace dataset
run_lora_fine_tuning: run LoRA fine-tuning on a causal language model with quantization and PEFT
run_image_text_training: run supervised fine-tuning on an image-to-text model architecture
build_sft_trainer: build an SFTTrainer with a model, training args, train and eval datasets, and optional PEFT config
create_parser_sft: create an argparse parser for the SFT training script with dataclass-based CLI arguments
